blocks.text: HELSINKI, Finland — A Ukrainian drone hit a Russian cargo ship, which caught fire in the eastern Baltic Sea, as Finland’s prime minister said Kyiv had the right to strike back against its “aggressor.” Hours later, Finland’s defense minister said a Russian helicopter was suspected of violating Finnish airspace and suggested a possible link between the two incidents. Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo suggested the incidents were related to the war between Ukraine and Russia, which began with Moscow’s 2022 invasion. “War is spilling over into our immediate vicinity… Ukraine has the right to fight back against the aggressor,” Orpo said […]...
